limits_and_corrections.text: No matching service or file in a named scope is not proof of absence on an entire machine.
Production-named directories are old native_v6_raft staging. Their exact data/raft/state directories were empty; none is accepted ordinary native_v6_file production storage.

r1 used ps comm. Apple primary implementation may read argument space internally; strict no-argv-read is not established for that observation. r2 used kernel ucomm. No actual credential leak is asserted.

r2 compared Docker init PID with the bao child PID and reported original_process_changed. This equality test was invalid. r3 retained actual parent/child start ticks and common container cgroup; executable hash remains permission-denied.

r4 receipt selection reached its cap before some final results. r5/r7/r8 exact-final reads supplement but do not erase prior gaps. Oversized generic dependency reports remain unparsed; historical references are not an exhaustive current writer census.

The 304644-byte named public source-map was read with an explicit 524288-byte cap in r7/r8; all jobs retained 52/60-second deadlines. Its 1261-entry list was counted, not fully revalidated or publicly reproduced.

A historical multi-path DropInPaths string was stat'ed as one string and a Mac reference was stat'ed on X230. Those absent rows are not evidence the actual individual/remote targets are absent; current Pocket manager projection lists each actual drop-in path separately.
Collectors refuse a symlink leaf where documented; this does not assert all path ancestors or ACLs were independently verified.
Historical passed receipts were read and artifact-bound. This audit did not rerun their recovery, open any database/key or verify current credential validity.

Original receipt hashes and raw tool results may bind earlier credential-dependent fingerprints. They remain private. Public artifacts contain an explicit allowlist projection, code/binary hashes and file metadata only.

Client SQLite/auth-profile stores and a captured application backup are source candidates for actual business data. They are not established authoritative OpenBao KV2 history, mount UUID, version/tombstone or current credential provenance.

remaining_gates.required: Identify authoritative non-J3160 source and complete business inventory; bind declared capture generation, credential provenance, source/mount mapping, versions and deletions where applicable. Existing application backup is dated 2026-11-02 and explicitly does not qualify current credentials/current full inventory.

Identify all actual writers, local/remote clients, systemd/launchd/cron/timers/extensions and backup consumers; establish an observable freeze or consistent snapshot boundary. Existing ROG main WAL is nonempty; file stat or idle gateway alone is not a writer fence.

After candidate qualification, continue within accepted existing roots with explicit ordinary native_v6_file config, latest pinned normal binary, manager ownership and protected custody; preserve staged HA config and original artifacts for rollback.

Migrate actual business source, independently recover with separate backup/key custody and old closure unavailable, verify complete declared inventory and old/new client behavior, cold restart and rollback. Synthetic full34/DR25 alone cannot satisfy this gate.

Only then real multi-host HA, J3160-independent AuthBus and per-machine traffic cutover; delete legacy services/binaries/intermediates only after every client and backup path has independent migration evidence.
